column1: # ApplyLabelSpec.java spec for /C132E0278.fullbin (2026-11-03): runtime globals read/written by
# ignition(), injection(), vvt(), revlimit() (+ their 200 Hz companions where they define the variable).
# Names/units derived from 0278 code; unit evidence in each comment.

column5: Over-temp spark comp = ign_comp_overtemp_rpm_base x ign_comp_overtemp_coolant_factor/128 (deg = val/4). Added in normal mode and to the knock ceiling. Was ign_comp_coolant.
Air-temp spark comp from CAL_ign_comp_engine_air[temp_engine_air], used only in idle/cruise modes (deg = val/4). Was ign_temp_engine_air_comp.
CAL_ign_comp_overtemp[rpm] (^0x80 signed), before the coolant factor (deg = val/4). Was ign_comp_rpm.
CAL_ign_comp_overtemp_coeff[coolant_temp] multiplier on the over-temp comp (val/128). Was ign_adv_adj_coolant_factor.
CAL_ign_comp_manifold_temp[rpm, charge temp] (^0x80 signed), before the load factor (deg = val/4). Was ign_comp_manifold_temp_raw.
CAL_ign_comp_manifold_temp_load_multiplier[rpm, load] (val/128). Was ..._load_multiplier.
Low-gear spark cap from CAL_ign_limit_first_gear_manual (deg = val/4); 0xff = no cap. ign_base is clipped to it. Was ign_adv_limit.
Per-cylinder torque-retard recovery step per 200 Hz tick (deg = val/4, no offset: compared raw against ign_torque_retard_per_cyl).
Spark events to skip after crank sync (reset to 12 in engine_sync_reset_etpu_init, -1 per ign ISR); spark/injection scheduling waits for 0. Was ign_startup_delay_counter.
(older 4-sample mean - newest 4-sample mean of engine_period_90deg_us)/15; >0 = engine accelerating. Axis for CAL_ign_comp_idle_rpm_rate. Was rpm_or_roughness_measure_unknown.
0 = not synced, 1 = crank/cam synced (set in etpu_ch0_crank_isr). Gates spark/injection scheduling. Was engine_running_state.
eTPU crank param 0x31: time per 0.1 crank deg in ns (init 1666667 = 10 rpm). dwell_angle = dwell_us*1000/this. Was eTPU_crank_angle_speed_scaling.
Per-cyl spark window armed (set at tooth table 0x400028f8 in ign_update_cyl_enable_by_tooth, cleared on fuel cut). Rising edge -> ign_schedule_cylinder_event enable. Was ign_per_cyl_enable???.
Previous-pass copy of ign_cyl_spark_window_armed (edge detect); also gates the per-cyl torque-retard recompute. Was ign_per_cyl_enable2???.
ign_base clipped to ign_adv_max_low_gear; base for normal/startup modes (deg = val/4). Was ign_adv_target1.

ign_adv_target slewed by ignition_retard_and_recovery_200hz (step_advance/step_retard every 10 ticks = 50 ms); bypassed while torque_limit_source_flags&0x3f (deg = val/4). Was ign_target_rate_limited.
Sum of normal-mode comps: driveaway + manifold temp + over-temp + test trim - tps-rate retard (+ startup base scaling) (deg = val/4). Also used by torque_model. Was ign_comp_rpm_accel.
Roughness spark comp actually applied (= ign_comp_roughness_request in NORMAL/NORMAL_STARTUP modes with roughness_flags&0x100, else 0) (deg = val/4). Was __ign_comp_roughness_detection.
Idle speed-error spark comp from CAL_ign_comp_idle_error (or _moving above CAL_vehicle_moving_speed_min), plus dashpot lift term (deg = val/4).
Driveaway idle-error spark comp from CAL_ign_comp_idle_error_driveaway[idle_speed_error_pedal_comp] (deg = val/4); 0 above driveaway speed/rpm.
Startup scaling of ign_base_limited from CAL_ign_comp_startup_tps[maf accum, tps] (val/255); 0xff = inactive. Was ign_comp_startup_tps (not an angle).
Startup spark retard from CAL_ign_comp_startup_* (stopped coolant x air since start), subtracted in idle/cruise modes (deg = val/4). Was ign_comp_startup.
bit0 stopped-coolant in startup window, bit1 startup comp applied, bit2 cruise target reached.
Throttle-rate spark retard from CAL_ign_comp_tps_rate (subtracted, zero-extended) (deg = val/4). Was ign_comp_tps_rate.
Charge/manifold-temp spark comp = base x load factor/128 (deg = val/4). Also used by injection power-enrich-from-retard. Was ign_comp_iat.
Fixed spark during crank + hold window, CAL_ign_comp_coldstart[stopped coolant] used raw, no -10 deg offset (deg = val/4). Was ign_coldstart_comp.
Idle dashpot spark comp from CAL_ign_comp_idle_rpm_rate[engine_period_trend_us]; 0 when no dashpot lift (deg = val/4). Was ign_comp_transient_total.
Idle speed-error spark comp while moving (CAL_ign_comp_idle_error_moving).
Held at CAL_ign_target_update_inhibit_timer*2 while engine not running, counts down after start; non-zero = IGN_COLD_START mode (ign_adv_start). Was ign_target_update_inhibit_timer_5ms.
Reloaded with CAL_ign_comp_recovery_timer while dashpot lift active; scales the negative idle-error comp back in. Was ign_idle_comp_recovery_timer_5ms.
Per-cyl (target + cyl trim - ign_adv_min - ign_comp_torque_reduction) when positive (deg = val/4). (0091 name)
Per-cyl retard subtracted from the final advance; decays by ign_retard_recovery_step at 200 Hz on cut cylinders (deg = val/4). Was ign_adv_with_torque_retard.
Per-cyl ceiling = ign_base - knock retard - octane retard + manifold-temp + over-temp comps; final advance clipped to it (deg = val/4). Was ign_adv_with_knock_retard.
Dwell converted to crank angle (dwell_us*1000/crank_time_per_0p1deg_ns), limited so dwell+advance <= 305 deg (deg = val/10). Was ign_volt_comp_angle_per_cyl.
Coil-on angle = ign_angle_scheduled - ign_dwell_angle_per_cyl, wrapped to 0..720 deg (deg = val/10).
Roughness controller spark request from engine_roughness_200hz, clipped to CAL_roughness_ign_adv_max/min (deg = val/4). Was ign_adv_from_roughness_detection.
Idle target incl. idle_comp_accel_pedal_pos*4 (driveaway target).
engine_speed_16bit - idle_speed_target_pedal_comp (RPM, signed). Axis for CAL_ign_comp_idle_error_driveaway. Was idle_speed_error_tps_compensated.
engine_speed_16bit - obd_ii_idle_speed_target_total (RPM, signed).
Idle target rpm lift (dashpot) after a high-rpm transient, decays in idle_airflow_decay_manager (RPM). Was idle_comp_high_rpm_transient.
CAL_idle_dashpot_rpm_lift_max[rpm]*10 (RPM). Normalises the dashpot spark comp. Was idle_comp_high_rpm_transient_max.
Cruise control state bitfield (bit1 = cruise engaged; also reported in mode 22). Was obd_ii_cruise_status.
Cruise-commanded pedal (val/1023; >>2 gives the 8-bit pps axis).
Torque-model spark reduction request (<=0) (deg = val/4).
Warm-up enrichment factor CAL_inj_warmup_factor_*[load, coolant], min 64 (val/64).
Cranking air-temp enrichment CAL_inj_cranking_comp_air_temp[charge temp, air since start], clamped 32..64 (val/32 = 1.0..2.0).
Charge-air-temp enrichment CAL_inj_enrichment_charge_air_temp[load, charge temp], min 128 (val/128).
RAM-only dev trim (init 0x80), added as (x-128)/2 to the bank balance ratio. Was inj_bank_balance_trim_unused.
RAM-only dev trim (init 0), adds 0.02 AFR per count to afr_target_base. Was afr_target_trim_0p02_steps.
RAM-only dev override (init 0): values >= 3 replace CAL_inj_angle. Was inj_angle_test_trim.
RAM-only dev spark trim (init 0x80 = 0), added in every ignition mode.
RAM-only dev trim (init 0x80), adds (x-128)/2 to inj_efficiency (1/400 per count).
Air mass since start weighted by cranking_load_weight (g). Axis of CAL_inj_cranking_enrichment_mass_accum. Was maf_accum_since_start_scaled.
Intake-air sensor temp latched while stopped (CAL_sensor_intake_air_scaling); cranking air-temp axis when CAL_tmap_use_for_inj. Was temp_engine_air_derived1.
Crank period per 90 deg (us): rpm = 15e6/val; 720 deg window = val*8. Was engine_speed_period_2.
bit0/3 rev-limit fuel cut, bit4 ignition off, bit5 cut counted.
Injector dead time = CAL_inj_deadtime_base[volts, dP]*20 us x CAL_inj_deadtime_comp_iat/100, max 5100 (us).
Bank-1 pulse for the required fuel mass: mass(10 ug)*10000/flow(mg/s) (us), before enrichments. Was mass_to_time_scaler_b1.
Bank-2 pulse for the required fuel mass (us). Was mass_to_time_scaler_b2.
mass_accum x soak x air_temp factors /65025; pulse x (1 + val/255). Was enrichment_cranking_blend.
Prime pulse fired at crank sync = startup offset + dead time, max 65535 (us). Was inj_startup_pulse_time.
CAL_inj_angle (or test override) x 7200/256 (deg = val/10).
CAL_inj_afr_base*5 + 500 + test trim (AFR = val/100). Was afr_target.
Base AFR target, forced to CAL_closedloop_afr during the closed-loop entry hold (AFR = val/100). afr_commanded = this - afr_enrichment_from_ign_retard. Was afr_target2.
Fuel mass per injection = load_mass_per_stroke_raw*100/AFR (mg = val/100).
Bank-1 pulse after the cold-start cap and the overflow clamp, before fuel trims (us). Was inj_pw_b1_pretrim.
Bank-2 pulse after the cold-start cap and the overflow clamp, before fuel trims (us). Was inj_pw_b2_pretrim.
Bank-1 pulse with all enrichments, tip-in/out and DFCO recovery, before the cold-start cap (us). Was inj_pw_b1_pretrims.
Bank-2 pulse with all enrichments, before the cold-start cap (us). Was inj_pw_b2_pretrims.
Bank-1 fuel mass after evap purge credit (mg = val/100).
Bank-2 fuel mass after evap purge credit (mg = val/100).
Injector efficiency CAL_inj_efficiency + test trim, clamped 100..255 (val/200; 200 = 1.0). Was typed /100.
Instantaneous fuel volume flow = rpm*flow*avg_pw/CAL density/15000 (mL/s = val/100). Was typed 1/10 mL/km.
fuel_usage_instantaneous*360/car_speed_u8 (mL/km = val/10).
Bank balance CAL_inj_bank_balance + test trim, clamped 170..230 (val/200): bank2 flow x val/200, bank1 x (400-val)/200.
Rev-limit fuel-cut events (cleared once rpm drops CAL_revlimit_release_rpm_delta*10 below target).
Time in rev-limit fuel cut (injection_flags&8), +1 per 200 Hz tick. Was u16_time_100ms_400019a6.
Bank-1 evap purge fuel / required fuel (val/255; 255 = all). Was mass_ratio_b1_prev.
Bank-2 evap purge fuel / required fuel (val/255). Was mass_ratio_b2_prev.
CAL_inj_cranking_enrichment_load[load] (val/25; stock 25 = 1.0): weights maf_accum_load_weighted_g. Was cranking_enrichment_load.
CAL_inj_cranking_enrichment_soak_time[engine off time] (val/255). Was inj_cranking_enrichment_soak_time_X_engine_off_time.
CAL_inj_cranking_enrichment_air_temp[air temp stopped, coolant stopped] (val/255).
CAL_inj_cranking_enrichment_mass_accum[maf_accum_load_weighted_g] (val/255).
Dead-time air-temp multiplier CAL_inj_deadtime_comp_iat (val/100).
Cold-start pulse cap factor CAL_inj_coldstart_enrichment, min 24 (val/16 of inj_pw_from_mass).
Closed-loop entry hold (cruise or power-enrich CAL), compared as <<2 to the 5 ms timer. Was closedloop_entry_delay_steps.
CAL_inj_accel_enrichment_load_threshold[rpm], compared with load_pct (val/100).
Rail-to-manifold fuel pressure (mbar = val*50); dead-time axis.
bit0 = decel fuel cut (fixed spark, zero fuel usage).
Post-start fuel multiplier offset: pulse x (10000 + val)/10000; decays to 0 in inj_transient_ramp_200hz. Was inj_trim_post_start.
Sum of ign_knock_retard_octane[6] (deg = val/4). Was knock_ign_retard_sum.
Bank-1 evap purge fuel mass per injection (mg = val/100).
Bank-2 evap purge fuel mass per injection (mg = val/100).
RAM-only dev override (init 0): values >= 4 replace the exhaust base target. Was vvt_exhaust_fallback_angle_zero.
RAM-only dev override (init 0): values >= 4 replace the intake base target. Was vvt_intake_fallback_angle_zero.
Max inlet cam position seen during the start-up park check, bank 1.
Max inlet cam position seen during the start-up park check, bank 2.
Max exhaust cam position seen during the start-up park check, bank 1.
Max exhaust cam position seen during the start-up park check, bank 2.
Min inlet cam position seen during the start-up park check, bank 1.
Min inlet cam position seen during the start-up park check, bank 2.
Min exhaust cam position seen during the start-up park check, bank 1.
Min exhaust cam position seen during the start-up park check, bank 2.
Inlet VVT solenoid duty = pi_output/2 + 400 (val/1000; 1 = off). Sent x10 to vvt_inlet_update_b1.
Inlet VVT solenoid duty bank 2 (val/1000; ~1/1024 via CAL_vvt_pwm_period*val>>10).
Exhaust VVT solenoid duty bank 1 (val/1000).
Exhaust VVT solenoid duty bank 2 (val/1000; ~1/1024).
Inlet cam position bank 2 (deg = val/4). Was obd_ii_vvt_inlet_angle_bank2.
obd_ii_vvt_inlet_target - inlet position bank 2 (deg = val/4). Was obd_ii_vvt_inlet_angle_error_bank2.
obd_ii_vvt_inlet_target - inlet position bank 1 (deg = val/4). Was obd_ii_vvt_inlet_angle_error_bank1.
Exhaust cam error bank 2 = target + position (exhaust position is negative-going) (deg = val/4).
Exhaust cam error bank 1 = target + position (deg = val/4).
Inlet cam target used by BOTH banks, ramped 0.25 deg / 50 ms toward vvt_inlet_target_requested in vvt_200hz (deg = val/4). Was vvt_inlet_target_bank1.
Exhaust cam target used by BOTH banks, ramped 0.25 deg / 50 ms (deg = val/4). Was obd_ii_vvt_exhaust_target_bank1.
Inlet base map (normal or low-load) - coolant offset, clamped 0..43 deg (deg = val/4). Was vvt_inlet_taget_calc_bank1.
Exhaust base map - coolant comp, clamped 0..35 deg (deg = val/4). Was vvt_exhaust_taget_calc_bank1.
Inlet b1 PI proportional term = error*CAL_vvt_error_gain_startup>>8.
Inlet b1 PI integrator (<<8), += error*CAL_vvt_integral_gain every 50 ms, clamped +-0x19000 (= +-400 after >>8).
Inlet b1 PI output = P + I>>8, clamped +-400; -400 forced after target==0 timeout (park). duty = val/2 + 400.
Inlet b2 PI proportional term.
Inlet b2 PI integrator (<<8), clamped +-0x19000.
Inlet b2 PI output, clamped +-400.
Exhaust b1 PI proportional term.
Exhaust b1 PI integrator (<<8), clamped +-0x19000.
Exhaust b1 PI output, clamped +-400.
Exhaust b2 PI proportional term.
Exhaust b2 PI integrator (<<8), clamped +-0x19000.
Exhaust b2 PI output, clamped +-400.
Sum of inlet b1 cam positions during the park check (1/4 deg units). Was typed u16 (it is a 32-bit sum).
Sum of inlet b2 cam positions during the park check.
Sum of exhaust b1 cam positions during the park check.
Sum of exhaust b2 cam positions during the park check.
Park-check sample count, inlet b1.
Park-check sample count, inlet b2.
Park-check sample count, exhaust b1.
Park-check sample count, exhaust b2.
Per-controller flag (bit0 in-b1, bit1 in-b2, bit2 ex-b1, bit3 ex-b2): integrator to be cleared when target leaves 0.
Counts down while the inlet target is 0 (reload CAL_vvt_zero_target_timeout); at 0 the PI output is forced to -400 (park).
Counts down while the exhaust target is 0; at 0 the PI output is forced to -400.
Mean (intake+exhaust) of active target - normal-map target while both cams are on the low-load map, 0..255 (deg = val/4); non-zero selects idle LEA offsets / alt spark tables. Was vvt_error_scale.
bit0 low-load map active, bit1 normal map, bit2 ramping to low-load, bit3 ramping to normal.
bit0 low-load map active, bit1 normal map, bit2 ramping to low-load, bit3 ramping to normal.
Cam edge watchdog exhaust b2: reloaded to CAL_obd_ii_crank_cam_error_count_max by the cam ISR, -1 per crank rev; also a new-sample flag for the park check.
Cam edge watchdog exhaust b1.
Cam edge watchdog inlet b2.
Cam edge watchdog inlet b1 (see exhaust b2). Was cam_edge_watchdog.
Mean park position exhaust b2; |mean| > CAL_vvt_cam_park_offset_max sets the offset fault.
Mean park position exhaust b1.
Mean park position inlet b2.
Mean park position inlet b1.
Park offset fault exhaust b2 (0 ok, 0xff = |mean| > CAL_vvt_cam_park_offset_max); blocks closed-loop VVT.
Park offset fault exhaust b1.
Park offset fault inlet b2.
Park offset fault inlet b1.
Park check done exhaust b2 (1 = done).
Park check done exhaust b1.
Park check done inlet b2 (1 = done).
Park check done inlet b1.
CAL_vvt_start_timer[stopped coolant]*20: before this runtime the cams are held parked and sampled; after it closed-loop VVT runs. Was vvt_start_time.
Mode $2F VVT test duty (val/256) applied to all four solenoids.
CAL_vehicle_speed_limit*200 (2 km/h units), 51000 = no limit (km/h = val/100).

bit0 airflow limiter active, bit1/2 flow setpoint stepping up/down, bit3 tps cap valid, bit4 escalated, bit6 fuel cut hit, bit7 speed-limit rpm active, bit8 capped by speed-limit max, bit9 speed-limit rpm valid, bit10 speed target ramping, bit11 overspeed.
revlimit_soft_target - engine_speed_16bit (RPM, signed).
Throttle cap from the airflow limiter: CAL_load_to_tps_mapping[revlimit_load_setpoint] - idle tps (val/1023).
Airflow setpoint stepped toward base + P + I by CAL_revlimit_maf_error_max_10g (mg/s = val*10).
revlimit_flow_setpoint converted to load minus idle load, max 1173 (mg/stroke).
Latched copy of revlimit_hard: fuel cut ends when rpm <= this (RPM). Also sent on CAN.
revlimit_soft - 2*trim_per_gear, lowered to the speed-limit rpm when active (RPM). Airflow limiter target. Was revlimit_current.
Limiter integrator: += error/10 per tick, clamped +-CAL_revlimit_integrator_limit*250.
Rpm approach rate = d(error)*10/max(error,50) every 15 ms, clipped to [-CAL_revlimit_rpm_rate_limit*25, 0].
Limiter P term = gain*error/5, clipped +-CAL_revlimit_flow_proportional_limit*100 (mg/s = val*10).
Limiter I term = gain*integral/100, clipped +-CAL_revlimit_flow_integral_limit*100 (mg/s = val*10).
Limiter rate term = gain*approach_rate/10 (mg/s = val*10). NB the +clip writes CAL*10 while testing CAL*100.
Airflow at limiter entry: min(maf, CAL_revlimit_airflow_threshold*2 g/s) (mg/s = val*10).
Escalation step = CAL_revlimit_escalation_integrator_step[gear]*25 (integrator units).
revlimit_rpm_at_speed_limit capped at revlimit_speed_limit_rpm_cap (RPM). Was rpm_speed_estimated_clipped_tomax.
CAL_revlimit_max_with_speedlimit when a speed limit is enforced, else 0 (RPM). Also caps revlimit_hard. Was revlimit_max.
Engine rpm that gives speed_limit_target_ramped in the current gear = target*rpm/car_speed (RPM). Was rpm_speed_estimated.
Cold-start reduction of the hard limit, decays by CAL_revlimit_startup_offset_decrement at 200 Hz (RPM). Was revlimit_startup_offset.
Cold-start reduction of the soft limit, decays like the hard one (RPM). Was revlimit_startup_max_offset.
IPS gear latched when the limiter escalates; NO_GEAR = none.
Cold-start hard limit (CAL_revlimit_coldstart_rpm_envelope row 0) or the normal one when warm (RPM). Was revlimit_coldstart_rpm_envelope_min.
Cold-start soft limit (envelope row 0xffff) or the normal one when warm (RPM). Was revlimit_coldstart_rpm_envelope_max.
Set to 40 (1 s) on escalation/overspeed, -1 every 25 ms. Was revlimit_esclated_timer.

column1: # ---------------- CAL types found while tracing these globals ----------------

column5: Closed-loop entry hold, cruise (x4 vs a 5 ms timer = 20 ms units; stock 150 = 3 s). Was typed u8_time_ms.
Closed-loop entry hold after power enrichment (20 ms units). Was typed u8_time_ms.
Vehicle speed limit (km/h = val*2; x200 into 1/100 km/h; stock 104 = 208 km/h). Was typed u8_speed_kph.
Cranking air-mass weight by load (val/25; stock 25..125 = 1.0..5.0). Was typed /255.
Crank/start fixed spark by stopped coolant; firmware uses it raw (deg = val/4), no -10 deg offset. Was typed u8_angle_1/4-10deg.
Startup scaling of ign_base_limited [maf accum x tps] (val/255; 255 = none). Was typed i8_angle_1/4deg.
Throttle-rate spark retard, subtracted zero-extended (deg = val/4). Was typed i8_angle_1/4deg.
Torque-retard recovery step per 200 Hz tick (deg = val/4). Was typed i8_angle_1/4deg.
Idle dashpot spark advance at full lift: x lift/lift_max into ign_comp_idle_error (deg = val/4). Was typed u8_factor_1/255.
